UNIVERSAL CENTURY 0096—three years after the end of the Second Neo Zeon War. The Vist Foundation, a powerful organization with great influence over the Earth Federation government, is plotting to hand over Laplace's Box, which is said to hold the greatest secret of the UNIVERSAL CENTURY. They have been secretly negotiating with the Sleeves, a Neo Zeon remnant force led by Full Frontal. Aware of the danger posed by the Sleeves, Mineva Lao Zabi, a descendant of the Zabi Family, infiltrates the industrial Space Colony Industrial 7, the site of the transaction, in an attempt to stop it.
A young boy named Banagher Links, who lives on Industrial 7, has a chance encounter with Mineva, who is using the alias Audrey Burne. He decides to help her in her quest. However, the EFF (EARTH FEDERATION FORCES) also moves to prevent the transaction, launching a military intervention that turns the colony into a battlefield.
Separated from Mineva in the ensuing chaos, Banagher searches for her and discovers a pure white mobile suit: the Unicorn Gundam. Becoming the Pilot of this machine—the very key to Laplace's Box—he is drawn into the conflict surrounding the Box.
What is Laplace's Box, which holds a century-old secret of the UNIVERSAL CENTURY? Now, its truth will be revealed.
